_doc: Repo-specific config for the generic burst-bug-hunter skill (Vela). Paths (initScript, verbs) resolve relative to THIS file's directory. driver-server.mjs reads readyExpr/resetExpr/initScript/viewport/jobTimeoutMs; the rest is documentation for the caller.
notes: Reset is IN-MEMORY: .hyper-sprint/render-offline.js exposes window.__velaReset (clears in-mem window.__vmem storage → app falls back to the baked STARTUP_PATCH deck, then remounts a fresh React root = all state reset, no reload), so ctx.reset()/vrun --reset is fast (~250-450ms). Use the ROOT .hyper-sprint/render-offline.js (exposes __velaReset); the canonical tools/vela-dev/scripts/render-offline.js does NOT. burst-init.js installs the in-mem window.storage polyfill (defines __vmem) so the debounced persistence path is exercisable offline; waitForSavedHeading proves the edited value reached storage. jobTimeoutMs 20s leaves room for the canonical readiness burst. GOTCHA: vrun's own default client-side wait (VRUN_WAIT, 15s) is SHORTER than this repo's 20s jobTimeoutMs, inverting vrun's documented invariant of waiting a few seconds longer than the server's job cap — a legitimate 15-20s burst can print vrun's client-side timeout error even though the server is healthy and would have delivered the result. This repo's combined server-side budget is 25s (20s jobTimeoutMs + driver-server.mjs's 5s recoverBudgetMs default), so a client wait equal to 25s still has zero margin. Export VRUN_WAIT=30 (or higher) before calling vrun/start-hunt.sh against this config — copilot-env.sh already does this; .hyper-sprint/test-vrun-wait-margin.mjs asserts the margin holds. GOTCHA: once the app enters fullscreen presenter mode (synthetic/real 'f'), Playwright page.keyboard.press AND ctx.shot HANG (headless requestFullscreen) — drive presenter keys via synthetic dispatch (navKey/presentKey/exitPresent verbs) + CDP touch + real mouse/wheel; take shots only after leaving fullscreen.
